name: Drape
description: The first clip hangs like a sheet of fabric that is let go at the top: it collapses into soft, uneven folds that hide one another as the cloth bunches up and slides down out of the frame, revealing the second clip behind it. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: folds
params.description: Number of folds across the cloth (fewer in a portrait frame)

params.name: depth
params.description: Depth of the folds and of their shading

params.name: sway
params.description: How much the cloth sways sideways as it falls

params.name: shadow
params.description: Strength of the soft shadow cast by the cloth on the second clip
